# Fire Risk North

> Fire Risk North provides BAFE SP205 registered fire risk assessments and fire safety compliance services for commercial and residential properties across the North of England.

Qualified, UKAS-accredited assessors delivering PAS 79 compliant fire risk assessments, fire strategy reports, fire door inspection and surveying, fire alarm testing, emergency light testing and fire extinguisher servicing. Written reports available within 24 hours on request. Serving Manchester, Liverpool, Lancashire, Preston and surrounding areas.

## Services

- [Fire Risk Assessment](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment): PAS 79 compliant fire risk assessments under the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, with UKAS accredited assessors.
- [Fire Strategy](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-strategy): Fire strategy development for new builds, major refurbishments and change of use projects, meeting Building Regulations.
- [Fire Door Inspection](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-door-inspection): Fire door inspections by BM Trada Q-Mark certified surveyors in accordance with BS 8214 and Regulation 10.
- [Fire Door Surveying](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-door-surveying): Regulation 10 compliant fire door surveys with photographic reports and remediation plans.
- [Fire Alarm Testing](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-alarm-testing): Fire alarm testing and servicing to BS 5839-1 by BAFE registered engineers, with compliance certificates.
- [Emergency Light Testing](https://firerisknorth.com/services/emergency-light-testing): Emergency lighting testing and maintenance to BS 5266-1, including full-duration discharge testing.
- [Fire Extinguisher Servicing](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-extinguisher-servicing): Annual fire extinguisher servicing to BS 5306-3 by BAFE registered engineers, certificate included.

## Fire Risk Assessments by Building Type

- [HMOs](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/hmo): BS 5839-6 alarm compliance, fire door inspection and escape route evaluation for houses in multiple occupation.
- [Flats](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/flats): Residential flats and apartment blocks assessed against the Fire Safety Act 2021, Building Safety Act 2022 and BS 9792:2025.
- [High-Rise Buildings](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/high-rise-buildings): Buildings over 18 metres, covering Building Safety Act 2022 compliance, EWS1 support and post-Grenfell requirements.
- [Care Homes](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/care-homes): CQC compliant assessments including PEEPs, medical oxygen safety and horizontal evacuation planning.
- [Hospitals](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/hospitals): HTM 05-02 compliant assessments for healthcare premises, covering progressive horizontal evacuation and medical gas safety.
- [Hotels](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/hotels): Sleeping guest protection, commercial kitchen safety, FD30 fire doors and multi-language evacuation planning.
- [Offices](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/offices): Office buildings and corporate workplaces under the Fire Safety Order 2005 and the October 2023 amendments.
- [Restaurants](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/restaurants): Commercial kitchen safety, TR19 extraction compliance and UL 300 fire suppression for restaurants, cafes and takeaways.
- [Retail](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/retail): Retail shops and shopping centres, including crowd planning, seasonal display compliance and electrical safety.
- [Schools](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/schools): Schools and educational establishments, covering CLEAPSS science lab compliance, Building Bulletin 100 and Ofsted-ready PEEPs.
- [Warehouses](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/warehouses): Warehouses and distribution centres, including BS EN 12845 sprinkler compliance, lithium-ion battery safety and DSEAR chemical storage.
